blocks.x: I feel you. Now all these rubber bands, is this for a particular reason?
No, I just put them all there to -- do you want to do some brushes?
Do I want to do some brushes? Do you have left handed brushes, (unintelligible)? Listen we’re getting close to about four so this is good, this is good. So should we come back the same time tomorrow?
Should we pack this up so we get it out of your way or can we just kind of put it off to the side somewhere.
You can put it off to the side.
We can put the mics over here? Like right over here in this corner.
Okay, that will be great. That will save us. When we get here tomorrow we won’t have to move the set up.
